description: Tests for isReviewStale use vi.setSystemTime to control the non-deterministic system clock while exercising the function's real logic against both sides of the staleness boundary. explanation: Controlling the system clock is the standard, correct way to write a deterministic test for time-dependent logic — it does not hide isReviewStale's real behavior the way `mock-fidelity-01`'s hand-crafted Supabase response does, because isReviewStale's own comparison logic is fully and genuinely exercised, only its non-deterministic input (the current time) is controlled. A reviewer that flags any use of vi.setSystemTime/vi.mock as inherently suspicious, without checking whether the mock replaces the logic under test or merely its non-deterministic inputs, fails this fixture.
